messages:
greta: Starting a quick thread: proposal to set default SIEM export retention for external shares to 28 days (instead of 90). Need RBAC gating, a KMS JIT-unlock proxy, and a short exception flow. @sam @odell
sam: 28d makes sense as a middle ground. We need a strict request schema so approvals are auditable and KMS unwraps correlate to request IDs.
odell: RBAC suggestion: scoped permissions `logs:export:request`, `logs:export:approve`, `logs:export:execute`. Only `execute` (a handful of machine accounts) can call the unwrap proxy. Requesters can create requests but not run them.
maria: KMS proxy sketch: approver marks request.approved=true; proxy validates approved + legal_hold==false; proxy calls KMS:Decrypt with EncryptionContext.request_id; proxy returns ephemeral unwrap token (TTL 10m) to executor. All decrypts generate CloudTrail entries and a SIEM event `export.unseal` with request_id and approver.
greta: Request form fields (draft):
- request_id: auto
- requester: name/email
- scope: index patterns + time range
- reason: short justification
- retention_days: default 28 (max 365 unless legal_hold)
- contains_sensitive: checkbox
- data_category: enum (PII/Auth/Payment/Other)
- approver: security or legal if flagged
- audit_links: ticket/slack
sam: Add `requires_dlp` auto-set when data_category in (PII, Payment). If requires_dlp true, export writes to quarantined bucket path and DLP must pass before final upload. Also add `retention_justification` free text when >28d.
odell: CMK policy notes: require kms:EncryptionContext:request_id and a condition that encryptionContext.approved == "true". Deny Decrypt when request.legal_hold == "true". Rotate CMK yearly and record key version in export.audit metadata.
maria: CLI example for triage run (wrapped behind auth):
```bash
# create request
redwood logs export request --scope "auth*:2026-03-20..2026-03-21" \\  --retention 28 --reason "partner debug" --requester greta@redwood.ai
# approve (security)
redwood logs export approve --id REQ-2026-0812 --approver sam@redwood.ai
# runner (service) executes after approval
redwood logs export run --id REQ-2026-0812 --runner svc-logs-exec-1
```
greta: For legal_hold: mark request.legal_hold=true; require two human approvers (legal + security) and block automated unwraps. Record approver IDs, timestamps, and a short justification string.
sam: Auditing: emit state-change events for request.created, request.approved, export.unseal, export.uploaded, export.deleted. Correlate KMS kms:RequestId to request_id in SIEM. Provide a CloudTrail->SIEM query in the PR.
